title: Repo-wide, filename-independent pre-commit hooks must set always_run: true and pass_filenames: false
answers: unused media check skipped on deletion-only commit
pre-commit hook not running when I only delete a file
how do I make a pre-commit hook run on every commit regardless of changed files
why does dev/find-unused-media.sh not run locally after deleting a doc
body:
Invariant: a hook that checks the whole repo rather than the staged files (`dev/find-unused-media.sh`, hook id `unused-media`) is declared with `always_run: true` and `pass_filenames: false`, plus `require_serial: true`.
Enforced by: .pre-commit-config.yaml hook `unused-media` (entry dev/find-unused-media.sh, language: system, stages: [pre-commit]).
What breaks if skipped: pre-commit builds its candidate file list from the commit's changed paths, and deleted paths are excluded. Without always_run, a commit that only deletes the last reference to a media file never triggers the hook, so the media is left unused without any error.
applies: Any new hook in .pre-commit-config.yaml that does not depend on the filenames it is passed.
says: Unused asset validation fails to run when a commit only deletes documentation.
Removing file references leaves orphaned media because local commit checks get skipped.
How do we force repository health checks to run on deletion-only commits?
Pre-commit checks ignore commits that only delete files instead of modifying them.
Ensure full repository validation triggers every time code or content is deleted.
search: Repository-wide pre-commit hooks in .pre-commit-config.yaml that do not depend on passed filenames must specify always_run: true, pass_filenames: false, and require_serial: true. Applies to any filename-independent hook, such as unused-media running dev/find-unused-media.sh during the pre-commit stage. Because pre-commit excludes deleted paths from candidate lists, omitting always_run skips the hook on deletion-only commits and allows unused media to persist undetected.
